name: Pope John Paul II
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1978 to 2005
contribution: The head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 16 October 1978 until his death in 2005.
legacy: As part of his special emphasis on the universal call to holiness, this person beatified 1,344 people, and canonised 483 saints, more than the combined tally of his predecessors during the preceding five centuries

checks.lead: Pope John Paul II (born Karol Józef Wojtyła; 18 May 1920 – 2 April 2005) was the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 16 October 1978 until his death in 2005. He was the first non-Italian pope since Adrian VI in the 16th century, as well as the third longest-serving pope in history, after St. Peter and Pius IX. In addition to this, he was an important philosopher and theologian of the 20th century.
